$comment: Recommended HTTP response headers for hosting Open Clutch XI, independent of any hosting platform. Rules apply in order; later rules add to or override earlier ones for matching paths. '*' matches any characters. See docs/development/hosting.md.

rules.why: Security headers for everything. All files come from the site's own origin: no third-party hosts. 'wasm-unsafe-eval' is needed by the meshopt model decoder (WebAssembly); JavaScript eval stays blocked. 'unsafe-inline' applies to styles only.

headers.Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; media-src 'self' blob: data:; connect-src 'self' blob: data:; worker-src 'self' blob:; frame-ancestors 'self'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'none'

rules.why: Hashed JavaScript, CSS and font bundles: names change on every build, so they can be cached forever.
The game's models, animations, textures, audio and flags have stable names: cache a day, then revalidate.
The page itself: always revalidate, so a new version is picked up at once.

spaFallback.why: Single-page app: unknown paths serve the game with status 200. Real files always take precedence.
